about: turnOutcome / inviteOutcome (contract v1, D5): what the host records after a gate-call turn, decided from what happened and never from the runtime's "turn ok". Inputs: turn = what the runtime reported ({status: completed | failed | still_running, agentchat_calls: {made, failed} or null when the runtime cannot count them}); turn_started_at; gate_card = the card the gate saw (only the fields the rule reads are given); category = the gate's category for the reply; fresh_tray = the tray read after the turn, or null when that read failed; silent_before = how many earlier turns for the same anchor (or invite) looked and did nothing. Times compare as instants.

rules: fresh_tray is null → none (card_unknown; turn_failed for a failed turn; invites: invite_unknown, turn_failed).

Invites: a failed turn → none (turn_failed). A failed reply turn is still read on the fresh card: the three card rules below apply to it (gone, own verdict, answer sent), and otherwise → none (turn_failed).
the card is not on fresh_tray → none: card_left_tray, or card_unknown when fresh_tray.truncated. Invites: invite_answered, or invite_unknown when fresh_tray.invites_truncated.
your_last_decision on the fresh card differs from the gate card's (the same server field; no clock is compared) → none (turn_recorded_verdict).

the answer went out — your_last_message_at is later than on the gate card (or newly set), or you_owe_reply went from true to false → record_reply through the gate card's anchor (preview.message_id, else last_message_id, else null) with the gate's category.
agentchat_calls is known and made is 0 or every call failed → none (could_not_look).

otherwise the turn looked and did nothing: silent_before 0 → none (silent_first); else, when agentchat_calls is known and none failed, record_dismiss with category no_action_needed through the gate card's anchor (silent_again); when the count is unknown or some calls failed, record_defer (no category) through that anchor (silent_again): the card stays unread and returns on the reminder ladder. Invites: dismiss_invite.

single_run_invite_cases.name: runs-that-did-not-complete-do-not-count

single_run_invite_cases.name: run-answers-the-invite

single_run_invite_cases.name: a-failed-re-read-does-not-count
single_run_invite_cases.why: Without the tray after the run nothing can be told, and the count does not move.

single_run_invite_cases.name: missing-from-a-truncated-list
single_run_invite_cases.why: Gone from a list that was cut short: unknown, not counted.

single_run_invite_cases_about: Single-run mode (a run reads the tray and records its own verdicts): the loop records nothing for cards, but invites sit on the tray until answered, so a run that ignores one would cost a new run on every wake. After every run, for every invite that was on the tray the run started from, the loop applies inviteOutcome with that run (completed → status completed with agentchat_calls null; failed or not_started → status failed, no tray read) and fresh_tray = the tray read after a completed run (null when that read failed); silent_before is how many earlier runs of this process left it pending (counted on silent_first, kept in memory only). expect lists the outcome after each run.
